'''icebreath Confusion''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[David Kangas|icebreath]]
* '''Published:''' 19 October 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS7]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers|Theed-L-naboobossnassschambers.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS7 NBNC icebreath LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Bionic Hand (V) (Virtual Set 6), Bright Hope (V) (Virtual Set 6), Uh-oh! (V) (Virtual Set 7), Civil Disorder (V) (Virtual Set 6), Flash Of Insight (V) (Virtual Set 5), Imperial Atrocity (V) (Virtual Set 6): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

My best non-objective ground pounder.

== Notes ==

* No objective; Naboo: Boss Nass' Chambers is the starting location.
* The four decks are the author's farewell set and post many unique cards in multiples (here Bionic Hand (V) x4, Flash Of Insight (V) x3, Luke With Lightsaber x2, Bright Hope (V) x2, Imperial Atrocity (V) x2); dested as posted.
* Original-era (V): Flash Of Insight (V) x3 (VS5); Civil Disorder (V), Bright Hope (V) x2, Bionic Hand (V) x4, Imperial Atrocity (V) x2 (VS6); Uh-oh! (V) (VS7, legal from 2004-07-19). The draft had dropped the (V) on Bright Hope and Imperial Atrocity.
* Posted 'Naboo: Ohta Gunga Entrance' dested Naboo: Otoh Gunga Entrance.

== Strategy ==

Second of four.  My final contributions to SWCCG.
